newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gunmen kill four in S.African police station.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill four in S.African police station.

text.p: Two men in military uniforms shot dead three policemen and a civilian in a police station in South Africa's crime-ridden Soweto township, police said on Thursday.
Newspapers said the killers used AK-47 assault rifles.
The three officers had been listening to a complaint by a civilian when the incident happened late on Wednesday night, Captain Sipho Ngubane told Reuters.
"The policemen and a member of the community were shot by two men dressed in uniforms normally worn by soldiers. So far the motive is unclear," he said.
The firearms of the dead policemen had been taken.
